---
description: 'UI guidance for Jinja, HTMX, pane layout, and card rendering consistency in PiDashboard.'
applyTo: '**/*.{html,jinja,j2,css,js}'
---

# UI Rules

- Build reusable pane and card templates, not one-off markup.
- Keep data rendering server-driven where feasible.
- Use HTMX progressively and avoid brittle client-only assumptions.
- Preserve responsive layout behavior for kiosk and smaller screens.
